text.p: Stone-Consolidated Corp said on Thursday it priced its previously announced tender of 10.25 percent senior secured notes due 2000 and 10-3/4 percent senior secured notes due 2001.

The company said that it priced each US$1,000 principal amount of the senior secured notes due 2000 at C$1,068.02 with a fixed spread of 50 basis points over the 5-3/4 percent U.S. treasury note due December 31, 1998 for a yield of 6.18 percent.

Stone-Consolidated said that it priced each US$1,000 principal amount of the senior secured notes due 2001 at US$1,100.75 with a fixed spread of 55 basis points over the six percent U.S. government treasury note due October 15, 1999 for a yield of 6.29 percent.
It said the pricing terms excluded accrued and unpaid interest up to May 16.
Stone-Consolidated said the tender offer would expire at 2400 EDT/0400 GMT on May 15.
